top_categories.workout_context: 116ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Reliance Deep Woods, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Reliance Deep Woods' TN mountains, Forest gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 70 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Reliance Deep Woods' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Reliance Deep Woods. Train it until it feels boring.
8,100ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
8,100ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
70 miles on tN mountain gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Reliance Deep Woods, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Low-cadence force work for 8,100ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on tN mountain gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Reliance Deep Woods’s 70 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Reliance Deep Woods requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on tn mountain gravel to build confidence. Expect: tn mountains, forest gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 70 miles of tn mountain gravel in Tennessee.
